[[File:Pyrefiend icon.png|left]]
'''Pyrefiends''' are [[Slayer]] monsters and followers of [[Zamorak]] found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. They require level 30 [[Slayer]] to kill, and are notable for their relatively high drop rate for [[sealed clue scroll (medium)|medium clue scrolls]].

A [[Pyrefiend (Soul Wars)|variant]] of pyrefiends can be found in [[Soul Wars]]. These count for Slayer tasks.

==Strengths and weaknesses==
Pyrefiends found in the God Wars Dungeon use melee, unlike their lower levelled magic-using counterparts. They are most susceptible to attacks using [[Magic]].

==Trivia==
* Pyrefiends used to have significant stalling on their combat animations, causing them to appear in a different tile from where they actually were. This was reduced with their graphical update in 2014.
